about: Skills and plugins the scan (.github/workflows/scan-plugins.yml) rates HIGH or CRITICAL, that a person has read and found harmless. The sha256 comes from the scan's report and is made from the files' contents: when the skill changes, it must be read again.

skills/security-and-hardening.why: Two Markdown files of security advice, no scripts. Every flagged line names a risk to guard against: .env files not to commit, the cloud metadata address to block, 'rotate it first, then purge history' for a leaked secret. The 'not fully inspected' findings are the scanner's own size limit on the reference file.
